pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 旁边 (pángbiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. House
   B. Fridge
   C. Beside
   D. Table

2. Which Chinese word means "things"? (1 mark)
   A. 花园 huāyuán
   B. 前面 qiánmiàn
   C. 东西 dōngxi
   D. 厕所 cèsuǒ

3. Read the pinyin: shāfā zài mén pángbiān. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sofa is beside the door.
   B. Where is the television?
   C. The bed is in the bedroom.
   D. The television is on the table.

4. Which sentence means "This is the sun."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是太阳。
   B. 今天下雨。
   C. 雨很大。
   D. 今天有云。

5. Which Chinese word means "small"? (1 mark)
   A. 天气 tiānqì
   B. 雨 yǔ
   C. 小 xiǎo
   D. 不 bù

6. Which word completes 卧室里有____? (There is a bed in the bedroom.) (1 mark)
   A. 冰箱
   B. 花园
   C. 桌子
   D. 床

7. What does 沙发 (shāfā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Window
   B. Chair
   C. Sofa
   D. Under

8. What does 牙 (yá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To touch
   B. Tooth
   C. To look, to see
   D. Shoulder

9. Which stroke rule is used when writing 好? (1 mark)
   A. Right before left
   B. Bottom first
   C. Left part 女 before right part 子
   D. Top only

10. What memory trick helps with 右? (1 mark)
   A. It has 女 in it
   B. It has 口 (mouth) in it, and we eat with the right hand
   C. It has 日 in it
   D. It has 工 in it

11. What does 谢谢 (xièxie) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello
   B. Thank you
   C. I, me
   D. Teacher

12. Which Chinese word means "toilet"? (1 mark)
   A. 前面 qiánmiàn
   B. 桌子 zhuōzi
   C. 上面 shàngmiàn
   D. 厕所 cèsuǒ

13. In the syllable jiào, what is the initial? (1 mark)
   A. ia
   B. i
   C. j
   D. o

14. In the character 人, which stroke is written first? (1 mark)
   A. 竖 shù
   B. 捺 nà
   C. 撇 piě
   D. 点 diǎn

15. Read the pinyin: yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a bed in the bedroom.
   B. The television is in the living room.
   C. The door is on the left.
   D. The chair is under the table.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 脚 and 休息. (2 marks)

17. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello! (polite)" (2 marks)

18. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喜欢 and 哪儿. (2 marks)

19. Say where the tone mark goes in these syllables: hǎo and liù. (2 marks)

20. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The fridge is in the kitchen." (2 marks)

21. Write in Chinese with pinyin: "I like to drink tea." (2 marks)

22. Give three ways to make a reading club work well. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Beside
   旁边 (pángbiān) means beside.

2. C — 东西 dōngxi
   东西 (dōngxi) means things.

3. A — The sofa is beside the door.
   shāfā zài mén pángbiān. is 沙发在门旁边。, which means "The sofa is beside the door.".

4. A — 这是太阳。
   这是太阳。 (zhè shì tàiyáng.) means "This is the sun.".

5. C — 小 xiǎo
   小 (xiǎo) means small.

6. D — 床
   A bed belongs in the bedroom.

7. C — Sofa
   沙发 (shāfā) means sofa.

8. B — Tooth
   牙 (yá) means tooth.

9. C — Left part 女 before right part 子
   Write from left to right.

10. B — It has 口 (mouth) in it, and we eat with the right hand
   Most people eat with the right hand.

11. B — Thank you
   谢谢 (xièxie) means thank you.

12. D — 厕所 cèsuǒ
   厕所 (cèsuǒ) means toilet.

13. C — j
   j is the initial. iao is the final.

14. C — 撇 piě
   撇 before 捺.

15. D — The chair is under the table.
   yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià. is 椅子在桌子下。, which means "The chair is under the table.".

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 脚: jiǎo, foot. 休息: xiūxi, to rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: 您好! nín hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: 喜欢: xǐhuan, to like. 哪儿: nǎr, where.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: hǎo: on a. liù: on u (the second of iu).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: 冰箱在厨房。 bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be kind and do not laugh at mistakes, listen while others read, take turns fairly and help others who find reading hard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
